sampling_policy: Bounded exact arithmetic domains described in template-extraction.md and classification-current.md; at most 1000 candidates per level per replenishment, deduplicated by normalized displayed equations. Exhausted search leaves a recorded shortage; it does not prove the mathematical domain exhausted.

source_errors.reason: Unstated first-row negation in final printed matrix
source_errors.action: Preserve source; exclude from validated inventory; correct stated row operations in generated variants
